title: Cobble Indicator
description: This resource pack adds an indicator for cobbled materials
body: Have you ever been looking for a base when out of nowhere you lose the path due to a cobbled block looking similar to a normal block? You don't have to worry anymore! This pack adds an indicator to cobbled blocks. ![Example with cobblestone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2f0165f4538f2baca1dde148e81551b4726f544_0.webp) (Picture from texture pack version 1.3)
